entries.en: The prince's silver coronet rested on a blue velvet cushion.
entries.zh: 王子的银色小冠冕放在一个蓝色天鹅绒垫子上。

entries.en: Please print the invitation on the museum's official letterhead.
entries.zh: 请把邀请函打印在博物馆印有正式抬头的信笺上。

entries.en: The documentary challenged the arguments that segregationists used to defend unequal schools.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片驳斥了种族隔离主义者为学校不平等现象辩护时使用的论点。

entries.en: Her latest payslip listed a separate contribution to her superannuation.
entries.zh: 她最新的工资单单独列出了向她的退休金账户缴纳的款项。

entries.en: An anthropomorphic teapot with little arms welcomed children into the cartoon kitchen.
entries.zh: 一个被赋予人形、长着小胳膊的茶壶欢迎孩子们走进动画中的厨房。

entries.en: The exhibition traces the island's history as a foreign protectorate.
entries.zh: 这次展览追溯了该岛作为外国保护国的历史。

entries.meaningZh: 接受能力；愿意接受的态度
entries.en: The team's receptivity to criticism made the revision process much easier.
entries.zh: 团队乐于接受批评的态度使修改过程容易多了。

entries.en: The impersonator copied the singer's gravelly voice and familiar stage gestures.
entries.zh: 那位模仿艺人模仿了歌手沙哑的嗓音和人们熟悉的舞台动作。

entries.en: The state's narrow panhandle stretches west between two neighbouring states.
entries.zh: 该州狭长的地带在两个邻州之间向西延伸。

entries.en: A retired steelworker showed us photographs of the old furnace.
entries.zh: 一位退休炼钢工人给我们看了那座旧熔炉的照片。

entries.en: The children recorded the date of germination for each bean seed.
entries.zh: 孩子们记录了每颗豆子发芽的日期。

entries.en: The freaky weather switched from sunshine to hail within minutes.
entries.zh: 这捉摸不定的天气在几分钟内就从晴天变成了冰雹天。

entries.en: A large broadsheet announcing the fair was pinned beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 一张宣布集市消息的大幅印刷品被钉在入口旁。

entries.en: A holdup at the warehouse delayed delivery of our new chairs.
entries.zh: 仓库的一次耽搁延误了我们新椅子的送货时间。

entries.en: His suggestion was met with derisive laughter from the back row.
entries.zh: 他的建议遭到了后排传来的嘲笑声。

entries.en: The astronaut described the strange sensation of weightlessness during the interview.
entries.zh: 那位宇航员在采访中描述了失重时的奇特感觉。

entries.en: The museum displayed a pair of gloves made from soft buckskin.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一副用柔软鹿皮制作的手套。

entries.en: The candle maker melted beeswax in a small metal pot.
entries.zh: 制蜡烛的人在一个小金属锅里熔化蜂蜡。

entries.meaningZh: 蹩脚而不时髦的（英国非正式用语）
entries.en: We laughed at the naff decorations left over from last year's party.
entries.zh: 我们看着去年聚会留下的那些蹩脚过时的装饰品笑了起来。

entries.en: The seminar examined how decolonization changed the island's schools and government.
entries.zh: 研讨课探讨了非殖民化如何改变该岛的学校和政府。

entries.en: The critic exposed the misogyny behind the article's dismissive portrayal of women.
entries.zh: 那位评论者揭露了这篇文章轻蔑描写女性背后的厌女思想。

entries.en: The builders subcontracted the electrical work to a local specialist.
entries.zh: 建筑商把电气工程分包给了当地的一位专业人员。

entries.en: Our babysitter read the children two stories before their bedtime.
entries.zh: 我们的临时保姆在孩子们睡觉前给他们读了两个故事。

entries.en: Their partnership benefited from the complementarity of her design skills and his technical knowledge.
entries.zh: 她的设计技能和他的技术知识相互补充，使他们的合作受益。

entries.en: The novel's regionalism emerges through local expressions and descriptions of village customs.
entries.zh: 这部小说通过地方用语和对乡村习俗的描写展现出地方色彩。

entries.en: The care plan included extra support for residents who were incontinent.
entries.zh: 护理计划为有失禁情况的住户安排了额外帮助。

entries.en: Even as a teenager, she was a resourceful moneymaker with several weekend businesses.
entries.zh: 她十几岁时就善于想办法赚钱，在周末经营着几项小生意。

entries.meaningZh: 逃避责任或义务的人（常带贬义）
entries.en: The film follows a tax dodger whose elaborate excuses finally unravel.
entries.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个逃税者的故事，他精心编造的借口最终被揭穿。

entries.en: In the historical novel, the hangman refuses to carry out the sentence.
entries.zh: 在这部历史小说中，绞刑吏拒绝执行判决。

entries.en: The publicity campaign was a smokescreen for management's plan to close the factory.
entries.zh: 这场宣传活动是管理层用来掩盖关厂计划的烟幕。

entries.meaningZh: 由第三方保管、待条件满足后交付的契约
entries.en: The deed was delivered as an escrow pending completion of the agreed repairs.
entries.zh: 这份契据作为附条件交付的契约交由第三方保管，等待约定的维修完成。

entries.en: Grandma served the chilled junket in glass bowls with grated nutmeg.
entries.zh: 祖母用玻璃碗盛上冷藏的凝乳甜食，并撒上磨碎的肉豆蔻。

entries.en: Finding her lost notebook brought her a moment of unadulterated joy.
entries.zh: 找到遗失的笔记本使她感到一阵纯粹的喜悦。

entries.en: The chef cut the sirloin into thick steaks for the evening menu.
entries.zh: 厨师把牛腰肉切成厚牛排，供晚餐使用。

entries.en: The map inaccurately placed the footbridge on the southern side of the lake.
entries.zh: 这张地图不准确地把人行桥标在了湖的南侧。

entries.en: She put her arm protectively around the child as the crowd surged forward.
entries.zh: 人群向前涌动时，她伸出胳膊护住了孩子。

entries.meaningZh: 雌狐（用于形容女性时可带侮辱意味，应慎用）
entries.en: A vixen led three small cubs out of the hedge at dusk.
entries.zh: 黄昏时，一只雌狐领着三只小狐崽走出了树篱。

entries.en: He spent extravagantly on parties while the family business struggled.
entries.zh: 家里的生意陷入困境时，他却在聚会上挥霍无度。

entries.meaningZh: 假小子（非正式，含有性别刻板印象，应谨慎用于他人）
entries.en: She described herself as a tomboy who preferred climbing trees to playing indoors.
entries.zh: 她说自己是个假小子，喜欢爬树胜过在室内玩耍。

entries.en: Two teachers volunteered to chaperone the students on their museum visit.
entries.zh: 两位老师自愿陪护学生们参观博物馆。

entries.en: Disunity within the committee prevented agreement on a date for the festival.
entries.zh: 委员会内部意见不统一，未能就节庆日期达成一致。

entries.en: The constant noise and uncertainty threatened to unhinge the exhausted traveller.
entries.zh: 持续的噪声和不确定性几乎使那个疲惫的旅客心绪大乱。

entries.en: The technician replaced the damaged strip with a piece of conductive tape.
entries.zh: 技术人员用一片导电胶带替换了损坏的带状材料。

entries.meaningZh: 响尾蛇（美国非正式用语）
entries.en: We spotted a rattler beside the desert trail and kept our distance.
entries.zh: 我们在沙漠小径旁发现一条响尾蛇，便与它保持距离。

entries.en: The historian compared the diary with contemporaneous letters from the same village.
entries.zh: 历史学家把这本日记与同一村庄同一时期的书信作了比较。

entries.en: A sable slipped between the trees, its dark fur barely visible.
entries.zh: 一只黑貂从树间溜过，深色的皮毛几乎看不清。

entries.en: The report described recessionary conditions that had reduced demand for new furniture.
entries.zh: 报告描述了导致新家具需求下降的经济衰退状况。

entries.en: He used a penknife to sharpen the pencil beside his sketchbook.
entries.zh: 他在速写本旁用一把袖珍折刀削铅笔。

entries.en: By pure happenstance, we booked seats on the same train.
entries.zh: 纯属巧合，我们订了同一趟火车的座位。

entries.en: A peal of bells rolled across the valley at noon.
entries.zh: 中午，一阵响亮的钟声传遍了山谷。

entries.en: Our school netball team practises passing in the gym every Thursday.
entries.zh: 我们学校的无挡板篮球队每周四都在体育馆练习传球。

entries.en: His apology sounded insincere because he immediately repeated the same accusation.
entries.zh: 他的道歉听起来没有诚意，因为他随即又重复了同样的指控。

entries.meaningZh: 忸怩作态的（非正式；形容表演风格，不宜据此揣测性取向）
entries.en: The villain's campy gestures made every dramatic entrance deliberately ridiculous.
entries.zh: 反派忸怩作态的动作让每次戏剧性的登场都显得刻意滑稽。

entries.en: It was frightfully cold in the hall before the heating came on.
entries.zh: 暖气开启之前，大厅里冷极了。

entries.en: On a misty autumn morn, the village bells broke the silence.
entries.zh: 在一个薄雾笼罩的秋日清晨，村里的钟声打破了寂静。

entries.en: Her interest in bodybuilding began after she attended a local competition.
entries.zh: 她观看了一场当地比赛后，开始对健美运动感兴趣。

entries.en: The waiter brought a breaded cutlet with potatoes and a lemon wedge.
entries.zh: 服务员端来一块裹面包屑的肉排，配有土豆和一角柠檬。

entries.en: The display used autumnal colours, with orange leaves and deep red berries.
entries.zh: 陈列采用了秋日色彩，有橙色的叶子和深红的浆果。

entries.en: The priest offered absolution after listening quietly to the visitor's confession.
entries.zh: 神父静静听完来访者的告解后，给予了赦罪。

entries.en: The pagoda rose above the trees on the far side of the lake.
entries.zh: 宝塔高出湖对岸的树梢。

entries.en: She wore a strapless dress and carried a shawl for the evening.
entries.zh: 她穿着一条无肩带连衣裙，带了条披肩准备晚上使用。

entries.en: An inattentive listener might miss the quiet change in the speaker's tone.
entries.zh: 注意力不集中的听众可能会错过说话者语气中的细微变化。

entries.en: The proposal rests on an unstated assumption about how people travel.
entries.zh: 这项提议建立在一个关于人们如何出行的未明说的假设上。

entries.meaningZh: 古怪的人（非正式，常有贬义，不宜随意称呼他人）
entries.en: The film's supposed weirdo turns out to be the kindest neighbour.
entries.zh: 影片中那个被说成怪人的人，最终却是最善良的邻居。

entries.en: Her final paragraph offered a clear restatement of the main argument.
entries.zh: 她的最后一段清楚地重述了主要论点。

entries.en: Stylistically, the final chapter differs sharply from the rest of the novel.
entries.zh: 在文体上，最后一章与小说其余部分截然不同。

entries.en: The tutor's explication of the final stanza helped us understand the poem.
entries.zh: 导师对最后一节的详细解释帮助我们理解了这首诗。

entries.en: A child placed a posy of wildflowers beside the old photograph.
entries.zh: 一个孩子在那张旧照片旁放了一小束野花。

entries.en: Each exhalation appeared as a little cloud in the freezing air.
entries.zh: 每次呼气都会在冰冷的空气中形成一小团白雾。

entries.en: The memoir describes the everyday work of mothering with warmth and humour.
entries.zh: 这部回忆录以温情和幽默描写了日常育儿的辛劳。

entries.en: The spilled flour caused much merriment among the children in the kitchen.
entries.zh: 洒出来的面粉让厨房里的孩子们欢笑不已。

entries.en: The old tree's knobbly roots pushed up through the garden path.
entries.zh: 那棵老树多疙瘩的树根从花园小径中拱了出来。

entries.en: The editor removed the salacious details that added nothing to the report.
entries.zh: 编辑删掉了那些对报道毫无帮助的色情细节。

entries.en: The closure of the mill contributed to the impoverishment of nearby villages.
entries.zh: 磨坊关闭，加剧了附近村庄的贫困。

entries.en: The laboratory tested how much tannin the bark samples contained.
entries.zh: 实验室检测了树皮样本中所含单宁的多少。

entries.en: A silver blimp drifted above the stadium before the match began.
entries.zh: 比赛开始前，一艘银色软式小飞艇在体育场上空飘行。

entries.en: She assessed the competing explanations dispassionately, setting aside her personal preferences.
entries.zh: 她撇开个人偏好，冷静客观地评估了几种相互竞争的解释。

entries.en: The story's alchemist spends years trying to turn ordinary metal into gold.
entries.zh: 故事中的炼金术士多年试图把普通金属变成黄金。

entries.meaningZh: 科学工作者（英国非正式用语）
entries.en: A cheerful boffin demonstrated the robot at the school science fair.
entries.zh: 一位兴高采烈的科学工作者在学校科技展上演示了那个机器人。

entries.en: The skateboarder landed neatly on the ramp after a difficult jump.
entries.zh: 那位滑板运动员完成一个高难度腾跃后，稳稳地落在斜坡上。

entries.meaningZh: 毕业典礼上的告别致辞者
entries.en: The valedictorian thanked the teachers before sharing memories of the class.
entries.zh: 毕业典礼上的告别致辞者先感谢了老师，随后分享了班级往事。

entries.en: The novel follows the consequences of an adulterous relationship within a small community.
entries.zh: 这部小说描写了一段通奸关系在一个小社区中造成的后果。

entries.en: The host offered a small glass of aperitif before dinner.
entries.zh: 主人在晚餐前招待客人喝了一小杯开胃酒。

entries.en: The apprentice looked admiringly at the cabinet's perfectly fitted wooden joints.
entries.zh: 学徒赞赏地看着柜子上严丝合缝的木质接合处。

entries.en: The historian linked the war to the empire's expansionist ambitions.
entries.zh: 历史学家把这场战争与该帝国的扩张主义野心联系起来。

entries.en: She rejected his insinuation that the judges had favoured their friends.
entries.zh: 他影射评委偏袒朋友，她对此予以否认。

entries.en: A single keystroke opened the search box at the top of the screen.
entries.zh: 只需按一下键，就能打开屏幕顶部的搜索框。

entries.en: The water tasted unpleasantly metallic after sitting in the old flask.
entries.zh: 水在旧水壶里放过之后，带有令人不快的金属味。

entries.en: Her unfeeling response made him regret sharing such a painful memory.
entries.zh: 她冷酷的回应使他后悔分享了那段痛苦的回忆。

entries.en: The suitcase was fearfully heavy by the time she packed the books.
entries.zh: 她把书装进去以后，行李箱重得不得了。

entries.en: The formal phraseology of the invitation confused some of our younger guests.
entries.zh: 邀请函正式的措辞让一些较年轻的客人感到困惑。

entries.en: The old nunnery now houses a small collection of religious paintings.
entries.zh: 那座旧女修道院如今收藏着一小批宗教绘画。

entries.en: The opal flashed green and blue when she turned the ring.
entries.zh: 她转动戒指时，那颗蛋白石闪出了绿色和蓝色光彩。

entries.en: He wrapped the remaining fruitcake and saved it for the weekend.
entries.zh: 他把剩下的干果蛋糕包好，留到周末吃。

entries.en: He regarded the move to assistant manager as an unfair demotion.
entries.zh: 他认为被调任助理经理是一次不公平的降职。

entries.en: A crystal decanter stood beside the glasses on the dining room sideboard.
entries.zh: 餐厅的餐具柜上，一只水晶酒瓶放在玻璃杯旁。

entries.en: A gazelle paused beside the acacia before bounding across the plain.
entries.zh: 一只瞪羚在金合欢树旁停了停，随后跳跃着穿过平原。

entries.en: The curtains were made of blue damask with a subtle woven pattern.
entries.zh: 窗帘是用带有精致暗纹的蓝色花缎制成的。

entries.en: The young draftee wrote home during his first week at the camp.
entries.zh: 那个被征召入伍的年轻人在军营的第一周给家里写了信。

entries.en: The debate contrasted republicanism with support for a hereditary monarchy.
entries.zh: 这场辩论把共和主义与支持世袭君主制的立场进行了对比。

entries.en: The cattleman checked the fences before moving the herd into the paddock.
entries.zh: 养牛人在把牛群赶进围场之前检查了栅栏。

entries.en: The silence became excruciatingly awkward after nobody answered her question.
entries.zh: 没人回答她的问题后，沉默变得尴尬得令人难以忍受。

entries.en: The beekeeper held up a honeycomb filled with golden honey.
entries.zh: 养蜂人举起了一块装满金色蜂蜜的蜂巢。

entries.en: A pink camellia bloomed beside the gate despite the cold weather.
entries.zh: 尽管天气寒冷，大门旁的一朵粉色山茶花还是开放了。

entries.en: The biography mentions several occasions when gout kept him away from meetings.
entries.zh: 这部传记提到，痛风曾多次使他无法参加会议。

entries.en: She served sauerkraut alongside the potatoes at our family lunch.
entries.zh: 在我们的家庭午餐上，她把德国酸菜和土豆一起端了上来。

entries.meaningZh: 远方风暴等引起的海面长涌
entries.en: A heavy groundswell from the distant storm rocked the fishing boat.
entries.zh: 远方风暴引起的强烈长涌使渔船摇晃起来。

entries.en: We ate supper in a candlelit room overlooking the quiet harbour.
entries.zh: 我们在一间烛光照明的房间里吃晚饭，窗外是宁静的港口。

entries.en: In the courtroom drama, the judge declares a mistrial after evidence goes missing.
entries.zh: 在这部法庭剧中，证据遗失后，法官宣布审判无效。

entries.en: New staff attend weekly training sessions during their probationary period.
entries.zh: 新员工在试用期内每周参加培训课程。

entries.en: She packed an extra pair of pantyhose in her overnight bag.
entries.zh: 她在过夜用的旅行包里多放了一双连裤袜。

entries.en: A seminarian helped the archivist sort letters in the cathedral library.
entries.zh: 一名神学院学生帮助档案管理员整理大教堂图书馆里的书信。

entries.en: The paralegal organised the case files before the lawyer arrived.
entries.zh: 律师到来之前，律师助理整理好了案件档案。

entries.en: Decompression of the downloaded archive revealed three folders and a short manual.
entries.zh: 解压下载的压缩包后，出现了三个文件夹和一本简短的说明书。

entries.en: I listened to a history podcast while washing the dishes.
entries.zh: 我洗碗时听了一期历史播客。

entries.en: The dancer adjusted her tiara before stepping into the spotlight.
entries.zh: 舞者走进聚光灯之前，整理了一下冕状头饰。

entries.en: The soldiers returned to their billet in the former village school.
entries.zh: 士兵们回到了设在原村校里的宿舍。

entries.meaningZh: 独特的表演套路（非正式）
entries.en: His usual shtick involves arguing with a puppet that always wins.
entries.zh: 他惯用的表演套路是和一个总能赢过他的木偶争论。

entries.en: The map showed the beachhead established during the first day of the landing.
entries.zh: 地图显示了登陆第一天建立的滩头堡。

entries.en: The firefighter acted heroically, carrying a trapped child out of the building.
entries.zh: 那名消防员英勇行动，把一个受困的孩子抱出了大楼。

entries.en: The old shop ledger records a charge of tuppence for a candle.
entries.zh: 那家旧商店的账簿记着一支蜡烛售价两便士。

entries.en: We need to redraft the opening paragraph before sending the proposal.
entries.zh: 发送提案之前，我们需要重新起草第一段。

entries.en: His obsessional concern with tiny errors slowed the whole editing process.
entries.zh: 他对细小错误近乎执念的关注拖慢了整个编辑过程。

entries.meaningZh: 针对族群的集体迫害或屠杀
entries.en: The memorial commemorates Jewish families who were killed during the pogrom.
entries.zh: 这座纪念碑纪念在那次集体迫害中遇害的犹太家庭。

entries.en: His fatalistic attitude made him accept every setback as something unavoidable.
entries.zh: 他的宿命论态度让他把每次挫折都看作无法避免的事。

entries.en: A heraldic lion appeared above the entrance to the old hall.
entries.zh: 旧大厅入口上方有一只纹章狮子。

entries.en: Our budgie chirped loudly whenever someone entered the sunny kitchen.
entries.zh: 只要有人走进阳光明媚的厨房，我们的虎皮鹦鹉就会大声啾叫。

entries.en: He slept fitfully as the night train rattled through the mountains.
entries.zh: 夜班火车在群山中哐当行驶，他断断续续地睡着。

entries.en: Morning light entered the attic bedroom through a small dormer.
entries.zh: 晨光透过一扇小小的屋顶采光窗照进阁楼卧室。

entries.en: The engineers studied telemetry from the test flight before adjusting the controls.
entries.zh: 工程师们研究了试飞传回的遥测数据，然后调整了控制装置。

entries.en: The actor girded his waist with a broad belt before entering the stage.
entries.zh: 那位演员上台前用一条宽腰带束住了腰。

entries.en: The celebrant welcomed the guests and began the wedding ceremony.
entries.zh: 仪式主持人欢迎了宾客，随后开始了婚礼。

entries.en: The actor delivered the soliloquy alone beneath a single spotlight.
entries.zh: 演员独自站在一束聚光灯下念完了那段独白。

entries.en: A cheerful lilt in the melody kept everyone tapping their feet.
entries.zh: 旋律中轻快活泼的调子让大家不停地用脚打拍子。

entries.en: The two species respond differently to heat, both behaviourally and physiologically.
entries.zh: 这两个物种对热的反应在行为和生理方面都有所不同。

entries.meaningZh: 脾气坏的（美国非正式用语）
entries.en: The ornery old mule refused to move until its owner returned.
entries.zh: 那头脾气坏的老骡子一动不动，直到主人回来才肯走。

entries.en: The reviewer dismissed the film's ending as a wimpy compromise.
entries.zh: 评论者把影片的结局贬为一种软弱的妥协。

entries.meaningZh: 传说中被偷换后留下的孩子（其他旧义可侮辱残障人士，勿用）
entries.en: In the folktale, the parents suspect that a fairy has left a changeling.
entries.zh: 在这个民间故事里，父母怀疑仙子偷换孩子后留下了一个替身。

entries.en: She played solitaire at the kitchen table while waiting for the rain to stop.
entries.zh: 她在厨房桌旁玩单人纸牌，等着雨停。

entries.en: The soldier crouched in a foxhole beneath the ruined wall.
entries.zh: 那个士兵蜷伏在残墙下的一个散兵坑里。

entries.en: Her remarriage brought two large families together for a seaside celebration.
entries.zh: 她的再婚让两个大家庭聚到海边庆祝。

entries.en: As a rationalist, the philosopher placed reason at the centre of his argument.
entries.zh: 作为理性主义者，那位哲学家把理性放在其论证的中心。

entries.en: Her outspoken remarks scandalized the respectable guests at the formal dinner.
entries.zh: 她直言不讳的话令正式晚宴上那些体面的客人震惊反感。

entries.en: A green hosepipe lay coiled beside the garden tap.
entries.zh: 一根绿色浇水软管盘放在花园水龙头旁。

entries.en: Visitors collected their tickets from the gatehouse beside the castle entrance.
entries.zh: 游客们在城堡入口旁的门房领取门票。

entries.en: The silver plating had worn away along the edge of the tray.
entries.zh: 托盘边缘的镀银层已经磨损脱落。

entries.en: The organiser used small boxes to compartmentalize the different craft materials.
entries.zh: 组织者用小盒子把不同的手工材料分开收纳。

entries.en: The speaker condemned xenophobic slogans and called for respect towards newcomers.
entries.zh: 发言者谴责了仇外口号，呼吁尊重新来者。

entries.en: A rocky islet lay just beyond the mouth of the harbour.
entries.zh: 港口出口外不远处有一个岩石小岛。

entries.en: His sinewy arms showed the results of years spent hauling fishing nets.
entries.zh: 他结实的双臂显现出多年拖拉渔网练就的力量。

entries.en: An onshore breeze carried the smell of seaweed into the village.
entries.zh: 一阵向陆地吹的微风把海藻的气味带进了村庄。

entries.en: She pulled a clean hanky from her pocket and wiped her glasses.
entries.zh: 她从口袋里掏出一块干净手帕，擦了擦眼镜。

entries.en: The congregation gathered for the consecration of the newly built chapel.
entries.zh: 教众聚集起来，参加新建小教堂的祝圣仪式。

entries.en: A small motorboat carried us across the lake to the island.
entries.zh: 一艘小汽艇载着我们穿过湖面，前往岛上。

entries.en: The congresswoman answered students' questions during a visit to their school.
entries.zh: 那位国会女议员到校访问时回答了学生们的问题。

entries.en: A newt slipped beneath a leaf at the edge of the pond.
entries.zh: 一只水螈钻到了池塘边的一片叶子下面。

entries.en: The painting shows the pontiff seated beneath a richly embroidered canopy.
entries.zh: 这幅画描绘了教皇坐在绣饰华丽的华盖下的情景。

entries.en: The operator adjusted the leveller before feeding another metal sheet through it.
entries.zh: 操作员先调整了校平器，再将另一块金属板送入其中。

entries.meaningZh: 窥视他人私密性活动的人（贬义）
entries.en: The thriller follows a voyeur whose secret observations are eventually discovered.
entries.zh: 这部惊悚片讲述了一个窥视者的故事，他的秘密窥视最终被发现。

entries.en: The tufted cushion had small buttons set deep into its fabric.
entries.zh: 那个有簇状绒饰的靠垫上，几颗小纽扣深陷在织物里。

entries.en: He packed everything for the weekend into a battered canvas holdall.
entries.zh: 他把周末所需的东西全装进了一个破旧的帆布旅行手提包。

entries.en: The storage box is made of polypropylene and has a removable lid.
entries.zh: 这个储物盒用聚丙烯制成，盒盖可以取下。

entries.en: After an evening of rumination, she finally decided to accept the invitation.
entries.zh: 经过一晚的沉思，她终于决定接受邀请。

entries.en: The official carried the ceremonial mace at the head of the procession.
entries.zh: 那位官员手持礼仪权杖走在队伍最前面。

entries.en: A humongous pumpkin took up most of the stall at the fair.
entries.zh: 一个巨大的南瓜占据了集市摊位的大部分空间。

entries.en: By midwinter, the mountain road was buried under deep snow.
entries.zh: 到了隆冬，那条山路已被厚厚的积雪掩埋。

entries.en: The objects were ritually washed before being placed inside the shrine.
entries.zh: 这些物品按照仪式洗净后，才被放进神龛。

entries.en: The survey revealed the pervasiveness of traffic noise across the neighbourhood.
entries.zh: 调查显示，这个街区普遍存在交通噪声。

entries.en: The workshop introduced students to lithography using a smooth limestone slab.
entries.zh: 工作坊用一块平滑的石灰石板向学生介绍石版印刷术。

entries.en: The children showed unbounded enthusiasm when the theatre doors finally opened.
entries.zh: 剧院大门终于打开时，孩子们表现出了无限热情。

entries.en: The shopkeeper described the men who smashed his windows as hoodlums.
entries.zh: 店主把砸坏他橱窗的那些人称为暴徒。

entries.en: The crusher broke the large rocks into pieces small enough to transport.
entries.zh: 破碎机把大石块打碎成便于运输的小块。

entries.en: The anatomy course includes a diagram of the main endocrine glands.
entries.zh: 解剖学课程中有一张主要内分泌腺的示意图。

entries.en: A camera recorded a puma moving silently along the mountain ridge.
entries.zh: 一台摄像机拍到一只美洲狮沿山脊无声行进。

entries.en: The top buttonhole was too narrow for the coat's large wooden button.
entries.zh: 最上面的纽扣孔太窄，穿不过大衣那颗大木纽扣。

entries.en: Guests lingered after the reception to schmooze with the visiting artists.
entries.zh: 招待会结束后，客人们留下来与来访艺术家闲聊。

entries.en: The label listed lactose among the ingredients in the powdered drink.
entries.zh: 标签把乳糖列为这种冲调饮料的配料之一。

entries.en: A copper cupola topped the town hall's central tower.
entries.zh: 市政厅中央塔楼顶部有一个铜制小圆顶。

entries.meaningZh: 第二次世界大战日本神风特攻队员
entries.en: The exhibition includes a letter written by a young kamikaze before his final mission.
entries.zh: 展览中有一封年轻神风特攻队员在最后一次任务前写下的信。

entries.en: We painted the doghouse to match the red garden shed.
entries.zh: 我们把狗窝刷成了与花园棚屋相配的红色。

entries.en: The detective refused to treat an unproven suspicion as an established fact.
entries.zh: 侦探拒绝把未经证实的怀疑当成既定事实。

entries.en: She remained uncompromisingly opposed to any cuts in library opening hours.
entries.zh: 她始终坚决反对以任何方式缩短图书馆开放时间。

entries.en: The physics lecture explained the basic distinction between fission and thermonuclear fusion.
entries.zh: 物理课讲解了裂变与热核聚变之间的基本区别。

entries.en: An iron sconce held a single candle beside the narrow staircase.
entries.zh: 狭窄楼梯旁的铁制壁式烛台上放着一支蜡烛。

entries.meaningZh: 带来晦气的诅咒（非正式）
entries.en: In the comic, the witch puts a whammy on the boastful prince.
entries.zh: 在这部漫画里，女巫给那个爱吹嘘的王子施了倒霉咒。

entries.meaningZh: 紧张不安的（英国非正式用语）
entries.en: The actors grew nervy as the time for their first performance approached.
entries.zh: 随着首演时间临近，演员们渐渐紧张起来。

entries.en: The photo misleadingly made the tiny garden look like a spacious courtyard.
entries.zh: 这张照片让小花园看起来像宽敞的庭院，产生了误导。

entries.en: The museum's model shows a wooden whaler returning to port.
entries.zh: 博物馆的模型展示了一艘木制捕鲸船返港的情景。

entries.en: The survivor's testimony identified the torturer who had worked inside the prison.
entries.zh: 幸存者的证词指认了曾在那座监狱里施刑的拷问者。

entries.en: The school marked the autumn equinox with an evening astronomy session.
entries.zh: 学校在秋分这天安排了一场晚间天文活动。

entries.en: The little dancer wore a white tutu for her first recital.
entries.zh: 那个小舞者穿着白色芭蕾舞短裙参加第一次汇演。

entries.en: The dancers performed a lively samba as the drums grew louder.
entries.zh: 随着鼓声越来越响，舞者们跳起了活泼的桑巴舞。

entries.en: She added a pinch of ground allspice to the cake mixture.
entries.zh: 她往蛋糕面糊里加了一小撮多香果粉。

entries.en: A heckler repeatedly interrupted the speaker with questions from the balcony.
entries.zh: 楼上一名起哄质问者反复提问，打断发言者。

entries.en: A thin line of dust had gathered along the white baseboard.
entries.zh: 白色踢脚板边积起了一层细细的灰尘。

entries.en: The campaign made an unlikely bedfellow of a former political rival.
entries.zh: 这场运动让一个昔日的政治对手成了出人意料的盟友。
